stories.title: South Portland library reopens after nearly weeklong technology outage
stories.summary: The reopening follows a cyber incident that disrupted city services and forced the temporary closure of library facilities

stories.title: Maine Republicans prepare for session after losing seats in both chambers
stories.summary: With Democrats maintaining control of the House, Senate and governor’s office, Republican leaders say they aim to be involved in tackling issues like Maine’s budget.

stories.title: CMP reduces tree trimming ahead of winter, raising concerns about power outages in Maine
stories.summary: CMP is cutting tree-trimming crews by nearly 60% and reducing planned maintenance by 20% amid financial pressures and an ongoing rate hike proposal.

stories.title: Maine delays enforcement of new MaineCare work requirements until July 2027
stories.summary: Officials in Maine anticipated more than 31,000 disenrollments in year 1 due to documentation hurdles and other challenges

stories.title: UMaine players safe after Quinnipiac University lifts lockdown amid reports of gunman
stories.summary: Authorities found no threat after Quinnipiac University was on lockdown for several hours Thursday night

stories.title: NEWS CENTER Maine Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Dry & mild through the weekend. Rain on the way Sunday night and Monday.

stories.title: Blue heron rescued by Kennebunk firefighters after being stuck in tree
stories.summary: A blue heron found itself in a precarious spot, stuck in a tree in Kennebunk.

stories.title: New bill would shield children from parents' Social Security debts
stories.summary: A bipartisan bill would aim to stop the Social Security Administration from making children repay benefits their parents received by mistake.

stories.title: Crash kills motorcyclist in Alton, Penobscot Sheriff's Office says
stories.summary: Drivers are urged to seek alternate routes.

stories.title: Route 15 reopened in Charleston after vehicle fire
stories.summary: Part of Route 15 in Charleston, Maine was closed as crews tackled a vehicle fire, with no details on the cause or injuries yet.

stories.title: Lawmakers press Maine Community Foundation over Lewiston shooting relief fund
stories.summary: In a government oversight committee meeting, lawmakers and families of victims questioned the organization about how the $6.6 million fund was allocated.

stories.title: GTA VI hype brings excitement to Bangor-area businesses
stories.summary: The buzz surrounding Grand Theft Auto VI is reaching the Bangor area, with local businesses and college students joining in on the excitement.
